problem_text:
A logistics coordinator must assign shipments to identical cargo planes. Shipments:
* Shipment Alpha: size 43 cubic meters
* Shipment Beta: size 68 cubic meters
* Shipment Gamma: size 58 cubic meters
* Shipment Delta: size 32 cubic meters
* Shipment Epsilon: size 45 cubic meters
* Shipment Zeta: size 61 cubic meters
* Shipment Eta: size 68 cubic meters
* Shipment Theta: size 50 cubic meters
* Shipment Iota: size 65 cubic meters
* Shipment Kappa: size 42 cubic meters
* Shipment Lambda: size 30 cubic meters
* Shipment Mu: size 32 cubic meters
* Shipment Nu: size 33 cubic meters
* Shipment Xi: size 38 cubic meters
* Shipment Omicron: size 45 cubic meters
* Shipment Pi: size 58 cubic meters
* Shipment Rho: size 69 cubic meters
* Shipment Sigma: size 44 cubic meters
* Shipment Tau: size 36 cubic meters
* Shipment Upsilon: size 63 cubic meters
* Shipment Phi: size 57 cubic meters
* Shipment Chi: size 70 cubic meters
* Shipment Psi: size 48 cubic meters

Each cargo plane has a maximum capacity of 100 cubic meters. Assign all shipments using the fewest planes possible. Every shipment must be loaded onto exactly one plane, and the total volume on any plane cannot exceed its capacity limit.
